observations: Photo 0 shows a metal mold with four bottle-shaped cavities arranged in two pairs side by side.
The cavities have blue-tinted interior surfaces and are set in a steel or aluminum block.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows four bottle cavities; it is unclear whether the item is one four-cavity mold or two two-cavity molds placed together.

risks.risk: The cavity count and configuration may not match the seller's two-cavity claim.
risks.proof: A photo showing the complete mold with a measuring tape, or a close-up of the parting line to confirm whether it is one unit or two separate molds.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single used mold of unknown cavity count at repair or scrap value

risks.risk: The bottle cavity surfaces may be worn, pitted, scratched, or damaged.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the inside of each bottle cavity.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working and requiring refurbishment

risks.risk: The mold may be missing its base plate, ejector pins, or mounting hardware.
risks.proof: Photos of the back, sides, and bottom of the mold.

risks.risk: The mold may not produce bottles or may leak under pressure.
risks.proof: A video of the mold mounted on a blow-molding machine producing bottles, or photos of sample bottles made from it.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the inside of each bottle cavity to check wear and confirm cavity count.
Photos of the back, sides, and bottom to confirm what hardware is included.
A photo showing the full mold with a measuring tape to confirm dimensions and whether it is one or two units.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a PET bottle mold from photo 0; even with unverified cavity count and unproven condition, it can be priced at its worst case as a used mold of unknown working order.
